subject: If the last 3 posts didn't make me smile..
author: ZombieTron
body:
I may have considered moderating this... but as it is, I think I will let this one slide. 🙂

Ofcourse, BurnoutAholics ethos is that if you love any of the Burnout Series you are a true Burner. Rofer doesn't like the current generation of Burnout, to put it mildly, and is entitled to his opinion. However, his views are not shared by BurnoutAholics.com and we welcome all Burnout fans here.

Especially ones like Suffur who make us smile, and give us 1 ⭐ votes for all of our negative blogs! Thanks for keeping us in check Suf! (when I say our I mean my and you can swap the us for me!)

Long Live Burnout! 🙂
